high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a presentation at the Reinforcement Learning Conference, as indicated by the logo in the top right corner. The slide is titled "The reward hypothesis" and discusses the concept of using rewards to define goals and purposes in various fields such as economics, psychology, control theory, and AI. Slide Content: The slide is divided into several bullet points: It introduces the idea that goals and purposes can be thought of as maximizing the expected value of the cumulative sum of a received scalar signal (called reward).
